o1.biggest_strength: The scripts feel like natural, high-converting UGC. Script 2 handles the $3 price objection brilliantly ('It's my one soda of the day, so I want a good one') without breaking flow.
o1.biggest_mistake: Could have included a bit more technical creator delivery guidance (safe zones, deliverables, licensing).
o1.what_would_make_it_a_10: Add standard production deliverables (aspect ratio safe zones, hook variations b-roll request) to the creator brief.

o2.biggest_strength: The 'Send with every brief' section is top-tier agency production management, covering UI safe zones, raw footage needs, and usage rights.
o2.biggest_mistake: Forcing creators to say 'Quick note, Olipop paid me for this' out loud mid-video. Burning 3 to 4 seconds of a 35-second ad on verbal disclosure destroys hook retention and ad momentum when platform UI toggles and on-screen text already satisfy compliance.
o2.what_would_make_it_a_10: Remove the spoken disclosure lines from the dialogue and let the native platform tags handle compliance so the narrative flow isn't interrupted.

reason: Output 1 delivers scripts that will actually convert on Meta and TikTok. Output 2 has wonderful production specs, but saddling every 35-second script with an awkward spoken 'Olipop paid me for this' disclosure ruins the pacing and authenticity of the creative.
